boardMembers.name: Mr. Okechukwu Vitus Agada
boardMembers.role: Founder, Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer
boardMembers.bio: Mr. Okechukwu Vitus Agada is the Founder, Managing Director, and CEO of Vitborah Pharmaceutical Company Limited. A corporate healthcare executive, administrator, and entrepreneur with over 20 years of leadership in pharmaceutical commerce and nationwide medicine distribution in Nigeria, Mr. Agada incorporated Vitborah in 2008 with a steadfast commitment to delivering WHO-GMP certified therapeutic medicines and essential dietary supplements to Nigerian healthcare providers, teaching hospitals, and community pharmacies.
boardMembers.executiveMessage: Our founding ethos has always been centered on one uncompromising principle: quality without compromise. Across our pharmaceutical therapeutic lines and New AGE wellness portfolios, we ensure that every formulation meets stringent clinical standards and remains accessible to the Nigerian populace.
boardMembers.committee: Executive Committee, Corporate Governance & Strategic Growth

boardMembers.name: Deborah Ukamaka Agada
boardMembers.bio: Deborah Ukamaka Agada serves as Executive Director at Vitborah Pharmaceutical Company Limited. She spearheads operational logistics, financial stewardship, national wholesale distribution networks, and strategic partnerships with tertiary healthcare institutions across Nigeria.

boardMembers.name: Pharm. Theophilus Agada
boardMembers.bio: Pharm. Theophilus Agada is a pharmaceutical professional who studied pharmacy at a university in Cyprus. He provides the core pharmaceutical expertise and scientific oversight behind Vitborah's therapeutic medicines and healthcare formulations, guiding product quality standards, formulation compliance, and clinical efficacy across the company's portfolio.
